newsitem.title: USA: Whittman-Hart asks share increase, may split stock. [CORRECTED 15:33 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Whittman-Hart asks share increase, may split stock. [CORRECTED 15:33 GMT]

text.p: Whittman-Hart Inc said Thursday it is planning to hold a special meeting on November 25 to ask stockholders to approve an increase in the number of authorized common shares to 37 million (corrects from 50 million) from 15 million.

Subject to stockholder approval of this increase and future market conditions, the company said it intends to vote a two-for-one stock split in the form of a 100 percent stock dividend, to be payable in December 1996.
Whittman-Hart said its directors believe that splitting the stock will benefit stockholders and the company by broadening its investor base and improving liquidity in the market for its common stock.
Whittman-Hart provides services to design, develop and implement integrated computer systems projects in diverse computing environments.
Shares of Whittman-Hart were trading up 5/8 to 45-5/8.
